description: The bar chart compares the self-report accuracy of two language models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, before and after introspection training. The vertical axis represents the self-report accuracy, ranging from 0.00 to 1.00, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis is divided into two groups, each corresponding to one of the language models, with the x-dimension indicating the weight assigned to an attribute by the model and the y-dimension showing the weight reported by the model when prompted explicitly. The chart includes three sets of bars for each model, representing the control, before introspection training, and after introspection training. The control bars are gray, the before training bars are light blue, and the after training bars are purple. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized. The error bars indicate 95% high-density intervals (HDIs).
